name: windninja
notes: WindNinja command-line build (no GUI, no OpenFOAM) on Linux. Cases: the three baseline runs, #348 (a 2-step job on an all-no-data DEM), #250 (two station names at one location). Every input is in the WindNinja repo or written by this profile. Use: behique check windninja <good> <cand> --profile casestudies/windninja/windninja.profile.json --repo <windninja checkout>

files.run.cfg:
num_threads = 1
elevation_file = {src}/data/missoula_valley.tif
initialization_method = domainAverageInitialization
input_speed = 10.0
input_speed_units = mph
input_direction = 270.0
input_wind_height = 20.0
units_input_wind_height = ft
output_wind_height = 20.0
units_output_wind_height = ft
vegetation = trees
mesh_choice = coarse
write_ascii_output = true
output_path = {run}

num_threads = 1
elevation_file = {src}/data/missoula_valley.tif
initialization_method = pointInitialization
match_points = false
wx_station_filename = {src}/data/WXSTATIONS-2018-06-25-1237-missoula_valley/KMSO-2018-06-25_1237-0.csv
output_wind_height = 20.0
units_output_wind_height = ft
vegetation = trees
mesh_choice = coarse
write_ascii_output = true
output_path = {run}

num_threads = 1
elevation_file = {src}/data/big_butte_small.tif
initialization_method = wxModelInitialization
time_zone = America/Denver
forecast_filename = {src}/data/20170603T1800.nc
output_wind_height = 20.0
units_output_wind_height = ft
vegetation = trees
diurnal_winds = false
mesh_choice = coarse
write_ascii_output = true
write_wx_model_ascii_output = true
output_path = {run}

num_threads = 1
elevation_file = {src}/data/dem/edge_case_dems/nodata.tif
initialization_method = pointInitialization
time_zone = America/Denver
match_points = false
wx_station_filename = {src}/data/WXSTATIONS-MDT-2018-06-20-2128-2018-06-21-2128-missoula_valley/missoula_valley_stations_4.csv
start_year = 2018
start_month = 06
start_day = 20
start_hour = 21
start_minute = 28
stop_year = 2018

stop_hour = 21
